content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy to build muscle. 💪 Research shows that sets taken close to failure build similar muscle across a wide range of loads, from about 5 to 30 reps. Lighter weights just need more reps and more effort to get there.

Your goal is a 100 kg bench in three months, and that's different. Strength is specific, so you do need to practice heavy, low-rep benching. Use heavy sets of 3 to 6 reps for the bench, then add moderate-rep work (8 to 15) on accessories for size. Ain't nothin' but a peanut! 🔥
